description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to article generation. The chart contains three slices, representing “Article generation,” “Article editing,” and “Headline generation.” The “Article generation” slice is red and occupies approximately 82.9% of the circle, while “Article editing” is blue and represents roughly 14.6%. The smallest slice, “Headline generation,” is yellow and accounts for about 2.4% of the total. Percentage labels are present directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged clockwise, with the largest slice at the top and subsequent slices decreasing in size as they proceed around the circle. A legend is not included, but each slice is labeled with its corresponding task type.
